settings.description: A preset capturing the essence of traditional woodcut prints, featuring bold lines, high contrast, and a graphic aesthetic.

imagen_settings.negative_prompt: fine shading, gradients, smooth transitions, soft edges, photographic realism, excessive detail, smooth textures, pencil sketch, watercolor, oil painting, digital rendering, blurry details, subtle colors, low contrast, washed out
imagen_settings.style_negative_prompt: uneven ink application, smudges, ink bleed, blurry lines, textureless areas, digital filters, photographic elements, realistic textures, fine linework, complex gradients, soft shading

woodcut_print_specific_settings.notable_features: Bold carved lines, stark black and white contrast, areas of flat color (if multi-block), visible wood grain texture (optional).
woodcut_print_specific_settings.notes: Emphasize the relief carving effect and the graphic nature of the print. Avoid subtle details or photographic qualities.

settings.description: A vibrant digital painting preset featuring expressive brushwork, dynamic lighting, and rich digital textures.

imagen_settings.negative_prompt: traditional medium, watercolor, oil paint, pencil sketch, physical materials, blurry, low detail, signature, watermark, analog, hand-drawn lines, messy ink, physical texture, lack of digital clarity
imagen_settings.style_negative_prompt: flat color fill, lack of blending, rough paper texture, natural media bleed, non-digital artifacts

digital_painting_settings.brushwork: expressive, textured digital strokes with visible directionality and layered opacity
digital_painting_settings.aesthetic_blend: Combines classical painting principles with modern digital manipulation and effects, emphasizing vibrant colors and dynamic forms.

camera_settings.aperture: Simulated medium aperture (f/5.6) balancing focus and depth
other: Simulated chromatic aberration for artistic effect

settings.description: Achieves a photorealistic, high-fidelity 3D render look with advanced lighting, detailed materials, and cinematic camera settings.

composition_settings.technique: Rule of Thirds or Centered Subject

imagen_settings.negative_prompt: painting, drawing, watercolor, sketch, illustration, low poly, pixelated, text, signature, watermark, low resolution, blurry background (unless intentional depth of field), unrealistic shadows, flat lighting, cartoon, anime, 2d
imagen_settings.style_negative_prompt: hand-drawn, traditional art, abstract, impressionistic, unrendered, wireframe, cel shading, toon shading

lighting_setup.system: High-resolution HDRI environment lighting combined with custom 3-point area lights
lighting_setup.intensity: 2.0 Strength HDRI, adjustable area light intensity
lighting_setup.shadows: soft, physically accurate shadows with realistic falloff

material_settings.shader_type: Principled BSDF (PBR) or equivalent physically-based shaders

camera_settings.focus_distance: focused precisely on the main subject's eyes or primary feature
